summary: The statement and proof are correct. Refutation checks covering singleton fibers, all-singleton classes, extreme permitted fiber lengths, both lower-endpoint parities, and the uniform two-point equality lift reveal no counterexample. The old same-parity pairs are in bijection with reflection-three centers, giving u_2=u_3. The restrictions on actual fiber lengths and the complete enumeration of integer midpoint heights are valid for arbitrary integer fiber locations. Each pair producing two heights forces a distinct reflection-three midpoint with a two-point fiber, establishing the required global charging inequality. Every entry and maximum in the local table is correct and exhaustive, and summing the local inequalities yields the claimed bound. The supplied accepted fact verifies every hypothesis for the concrete twenty-point base, and its Boolean product verifies sharpness and the stated dimension, parity, and reflection properties.
